snippet.title: Wild Bonds - Trailer | A Cozy 3D Exploration Time-Attack Game About a Little Fox (Steam)
snippet.description:
Play as a little fox and help the forest animals find what they've lost!

Wild Bonds is a 3D exploration time-attack game. Each request hides three items in random spots, and a mischievous fox may run off with one. Dash through the woods, beat the 3-minute clock, and climb the global Steam leaderboard.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5397750/

Platform: PC (Steam / Windows)
Price: $4.99
Languages: English, Japanese
Developer: UNLOCK X LAB
X: https://x.com/UNLOCK_X_LAB

Streaming and monetized videos are welcome.
